application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
site_name: Chase Lane Primary School York Road, Chingford, London, E4 8LA
description: Works to trees protected by preservation order. Poplar x1 (07) - Remove 1m section of Ivy from ground level using hand tools only and re-inspect base. Robinia x1 (09) -  Carefully fell to near ground level due to it being a veteranized tree with audibly hollow main stem in places.

residential_units.description: Construction of a three storey rear extension (including roof terraces to upper floor levels), dormer roof extension to main rear roof including raising the height of the existing ridge together with installation of five roof-lights to front roof and new shop front to ground floor commercial space to facilitate conversion of existing building to provide two commercial units (Use Class E) at ground and basement level, and 8 residential units (5x2-bed, 2x1-bed, 1xstudio) at first, second and third floor levels with associated soft and hard landscaping, service bay and bicycle and refuse storage facilities to rear.
